name: nxapi-wrapper
description: nxapi sidecar wrapper for geartoon Tauri app

scripts.build:win: npm run patch-config && npx @yao-pkg/pkg wrapper.mjs --target node20-win-x64 --output ../../app/src-tauri/binaries/nxapi-sidecar-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
scripts.build:mac-arm: npm run patch-config && npx @yao-pkg/pkg wrapper.mjs --target node20-macos-arm64 --output ../../app/src-tauri/binaries/nxapi-sidecar-aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac-x64: npm run patch-config && npx @yao-pkg/pkg wrapper.mjs --target node20-macos-x64 --output ../../app/src-tauri/binaries/nxapi-sidecar-x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:linux: npm run patch-config && npx @yao-pkg/pkg wrapper.mjs --target node20-linux-x64 --output ../../app/src-tauri/binaries/nxapi-sidecar-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
